blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro – Health reform advocate Dr. Anthony “Tony” Leachon has denounced continuing attempts to silence him as a vital witness in pending criminal cases involving the state-sponsored Dengvaxia vaccinations now being heard by a Quezon City Regional Trial Court. In a statement on Wednesday, Leachon, a resident doctor at Manila Doctors Hospital, confirmed he would appear again for upcoming trial sessions. The latest complaints against Leachon, filed on October 26 before the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC), challenged the medical and scientific basis of Leachon’s various public medical claims and the scope of his professional expertise.
